annotations.text:
Scroll surfaces in the console: runlist, tree (both axes), detail, events, diffs, review panes, console, prompt textarea.

All eight get one treatment. Pick a rail below, then the Signal ticks are an add-on for the two data-bearing ones.
These three scroll for real — wheel them, then hover the rail itself. The difference is in the hover, not the still frame.

Firefox only supports scrollbar-width + scrollbar-color, so it gets a thin themed rail but no hover growth. Chrome/Edge/Safari get all of it. Option C's ticks are real elements, so they work everywhere.
